extracted.intended_audience: USPTO officials, patent examiners, patent practitioners, and applicants
extracted.subtask_description: List of petition and request types and the USPTO officials or offices authorized to decide them, including statutory/regulatory citations and cross-references to MPEP sections. Useful for determining where to file and which office/official will decide a given petition or request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to revive abandoned application (unintentional delay)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to revive an abandoned national, nonprovisional or provisional patent application on the basis of unintentional delay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.183 (waiver/suspension of rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.183 for waiver or suspension of rules not otherwise provided for.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to invoke Director supervisory authority (37 CFR 1.181)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to invoke the supervisory authority of the Director of the USPTO under 37 CFR 1.181 in matters not otherwise provided for.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions for unintentionally delayed foreign priority claim
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for an unintentionally delayed foreign priority claim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.182 (matters not otherwise provided for)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.182 in matters not otherwise provided for in the regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for rehearing of PTAB decision (examiner requests)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests from the examiner for the rehearing of a decision of the Patent Trial and Appeal Board.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP § 1214.04; related to requests for rehearing routed via appropriate offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to review refusal to accept maintenance fee payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to review refusal to accept and record maintenance fee payment filed prior to the expiration of a patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to restore foreign priority right
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to restore the right of foreign priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to accept unintentionally delayed maintenance fee in expired patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to accept an unintentionally delayed payment of maintenance fee in an expired patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions for late filing of certified copy of foreign application
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for late filing of certified copy of foreign application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to review decision of Technology Center or CRU Director
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to review a decision of Technology Center Director or Central Reexamination Unit Director.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions for unintentionally delayed domestic benefit claim
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for an unintentionally delayed domestic benefit claim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to withdraw a holding of abandonment (not otherwise delegated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to withdraw a holding of abandonment not otherwise delegated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to restore benefit of provisional application
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to restore the benefit of a provisional application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to defer issuance of patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to defer issuance of patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions for express abandonment after issue fee payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for express abandonment of patent applications after payment of the issue fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests to order a Director reexamination proceeding
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests to order a Director reexamination proceeding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to accept late papers in reexamination (unintentional delay)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to accept late papers in a reexamination proceeding based upon unintentional delay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions for access to patent applications under 37 CFR 1.14
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for access to patent applications under 37 CFR 1.14 (or pre-AIA 37 CFR 1.14) with exceptions for applications involved in or related to PTAB proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions relating to issuance of patents not otherwise provided for
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions relating to issuance of patents not otherwise provided for, for example, issuance of a patent in the name of an assignee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: issuance in the name of an assignee under 37 CFR 3.81.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions relating to reexamination and/or reissue proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions relating to reexamination proceedings and/or reissue proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions for withdrawal of attorney or agent of record (Office of Petitions matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for the withdrawal of attorney or agent of record under 37 CFR 1.36 in patent applications involved before the Deputy Commissioner for Patents or assigned staff in the Office of Petitions/Patent Legal Administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 37 CFR 1.36; see related MPEP sections and delegation notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions relating to merger of reexamination and reissue proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions relating to merger of reexamination and reissue proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications and petitions relating to Hatch-Waxman patent term extension
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications relating to Hatch-Waxman patent term extension and petitions relating to Hatch-Waxman patent term extension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to review patent term extension length determinations
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.181 to review a determination of the length of the patent term extension under 37 CFR 1.701 for original applications filed between specified dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 37 CFR 1.181; MPEP § 2720; applicable filing-date windows noted in MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for reconsideration of patent term adjustment
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for reconsideration of the patent term adjustment indicated in the notice of allowance or in the patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for reinstatement of reduced patent term adjustment period
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for reinstatement of the period of patent term adjustment reduced pursuant to 37 CFR 1.704(b) under 37 CFR 1.705(c).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions relating to filing date of patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions relating to the filing date of patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to convert nonprovisional to provisional (Office of Petitions/Admin matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to convert a nonprovisional application filed under 37 CFR 1.53(b) to a provisional application under 37 CFR 1.53(c) where the nonprovisional application is before the Office of Petitions or Patent Legal Administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests to convert provisional to nonprovisional (Office of Petitions/Admin matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests to convert a provisional application filed under 37 CFR 1.53(c) to a nonprovisional application under 37 CFR 1.53(b) where the provisional application is before the Office of Petitions or Patent Legal Administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions for extensions of time (Office of Petitions/Patent Legal Administration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for extensions of time under 37 CFR 1.136(b) in applications before the Office of Petitions or the Office of Patent Legal Administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions/requests to withdraw applications from issue (USPTO initiative before fee payment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions, or requests at the initiative of the USPTO by someone other than a Technology Center Director, to withdraw patent applications from issue under 37 CFR 1.313(a) before payment of the issue fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions/requests to withdraw applications from issue (USPTO initiative after fee payment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions, or requests at the initiative of the USPTO by someone other than a Technology Center Director, to withdraw patent applications from issue after payment of the issue fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to withdraw patent applications from issue after issue fee payment (applicant-filed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to withdraw patent applications from issue after payment of the issue fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to expunge papers or assignment info (non-IDS submissions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to expunge papers or assignment information from patent applications under 37 CFR 1.59 which were not submitted under MPEP § 724.02 or as part of an information disclosure statement (IDS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to expunge recorded assignment information
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to expunge recorded assignment information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to Make Special (inventor's health)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to Make Special based on inventor’s health.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to Make Special (inventor's age)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to Make Special based on inventor’s age.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for prioritized examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for prioritized examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for participation in Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for participation in a Patent Prosecution Highway program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for participation in Law School Pilot Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for participation in the Law School Pilot Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program-specific guidance as described by USPTO pilot rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions for retroactive foreign filing license
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for retroactive foreign filing license.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to show proprietary interest to act on behalf of inventor
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to show proprietary interest sufficient to make application on behalf of and as agent for the inventor (applicable for applications filed on/after Sep 16, 2012).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to accept oath/declaration without joint inventor's signature (pre-AIA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to accept an oath or declaration without a joint inventor’s signature (pre-AIA, applicable to certain filing dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-AIA 37 CFR 1.47(a); MPEP § 409.03(a); applicable to applications filed before Sep 16, 2012.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to accept oath/declaration from assignee or person with proprietary interest (pre-AIA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to accept an oath or declaration from a person to whom an inventor has assigned or agreed in writing to assign the invention, or who otherwise shows sufficient proprietary interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-AIA 37 CFR 1.47(b); MPEP § 409.03(b); applicable filing-date limitations apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for Corrected Patent Application Publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for Corrected Patent Application Publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Considerations for corrected publication requests (prematureness, new matter, affidavits, refusal to enter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Factors relevant to corrected patent application publication requests, including prematureness of final rejection; requirement to cancel 'new matter' from specification; formal sufficiency/propriety of affidavits under 37 CFR 1.131(a) or 1.132; refusal to enter an amendment under 37 CFR 1.312.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to change entity status (including additional fees)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to change entity status, including the payment of additional fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Return of papers containing discourteous remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Return of papers containing discourteous remarks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to issue a corrected patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to issue a corrected patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for certificate of correction affecting related application or foreign priority data
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for a certificate of correction that affects related U.S. application data or foreign priority data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pertains to corrections that impact related application/priority information; procedural references in MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions/requests to reopen prosecution or reinstate rejection after PTAB decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions or requests to reopen prosecution of patent applications or to reinstate a rejection after decision by the Patent Trial and Appeal Board under 37 CFR 1.198, where no court action has been filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP §§ 1214.04 and 1214.07; decided by Technology Center Directors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.144 after restriction requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.144 after requirement for restriction by an examiner in a patent application, including final requirements finding lack of unity for national stage and protests following USPTO lack-of-unity holdings as ISA/IPEA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions invoking Director supervisory authority for ex parte examiner actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions invoking the supervisory authority of the Director under 37 CFR 1.181 involving any ex parte action or requirement in a patent application by the examiner which is not subject to appeal and not otherwise provided for (with examples).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include refusal to enter an amendment (MPEP § 714.19), refusal to enter under 1.111/1.115 (MPEP §§ 714.01(e), 714.03(a)), resetting reply periods due to mail delay (MPEP § 710.06), requirement for information under 37 CFR 1.105 (MPEP § 704.14(c)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.113 (objections/requirements by examiners)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.113 relating to objections or requirements made by the examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for extension of shortened statutory period (Technology Center)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for extensions of a set shortened statutory period under 37 CFR 1.136(b) in applications pending in the Technology Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions under 37 CFR 41.40 for review of failure to designate new ground of rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 41.40 to request review of the primary examiner’s failure to designate a rejection in the examiner’s answer as a new ground of rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions concerning appealed patent applications before transfer to PTAB
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions concerning appealed patent applications or ex parte reexamination proceedings before transfer of jurisdiction to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (e.g., extensions of time for filing an appeal brief).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP § 1205.01; examples include 37 CFR 1.136(b) or 1.550(c) extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions from refusal to issue certificate of correction for patent not in interference
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions from refusal to issue a certificate of correction for a patent not in an interference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to reinstate appeals dismissed in Technology Center
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to reinstate appeals dismissed in the Technology Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP § 1205.01 and related procedural sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions from denial of request for reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions from the denial of a request for reexamination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for extension of time in ex parte reexamination proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for extension of time in ex parte reexamination proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions regarding sequence rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions regarding sequence rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.129(b)(2) traversing a transitional restriction requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.129(b)(2) traversing a restriction requirement made in an application which is subject to the transitional restriction provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to convert nonprovisional to provisional (Technology Center matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to convert a nonprovisional application filed under 37 CFR 1.53(b) to a provisional application under 37 CFR 1.53(c) where the nonprovisional application is before the Technology Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for interviews with examiner after Notice of Allowability or after transfer to PTAB
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for interviews with examiner after a patent application has been sent to issue (Notice of Allowability mailed), or after transfer of jurisdiction to the PTAB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to expunge papers submitted under MPEP §724.02 or as part of an IDS (Technology Center)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to expunge papers from patent applications under 37 CFR 1.59 which were submitted under MPEP § 724.02 or as part of an information disclosure statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions/requests to withdraw applications from issue before payment of issue fee (Technology Center)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions, or requests at the initiative of the USPTO, to withdraw patent applications from issue before payment of the issue fee where the application is before the Technology Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests to withdraw applications from issue after issue fee payment (Technology Center)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests at the initiative of the USPTO to withdraw patent applications from issue after payment of the issue fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.91 to admit model or exhibit as part of record
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.91 to admit a model or exhibit as part of the record of an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for return of models, exhibits, or specimens
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for the return of models, exhibits, or specimen under 37 CFR 1.94.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for second or subsequent suspension of action (applicant request)
rubrics_metrics.description: Request by applicant for a second or subsequent suspension of action in patent applications under 37 CFR 1.103(a), regardless of which rule the first/prior request for suspension was based on.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for certificate of statement of availability of deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Request for a certificate of statement of availability of deposit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions decided by Director of Technology Center who Oversees Licensing and Review (US-owned applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Authority to decide petitions for extensions of time under 35 U.S.C. 267 for U.S.-owned applications important to armament/defense and related petitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP § 710; delegation to Director who Oversees Licensing and Review; includes petitions under 37 CFR 1.103(f) and various secrecy/foreign license matters (37 CFR 5.12(b), 5.4, 5.5(b),(c)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions relating to publication/statutory invention registration (rescind/refuse)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions relating to refusal to publish or rescission/withdrawal of publication requests for a Statutory Invention Registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 37 CFR 1.295 and 1.296 (as in effect on March 15, 2013); MPEP references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions relating to DOE/NASA property rights statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions relating to DOE property rights statements and NASA property rights statements under relevant statutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions relating to foreign filing licenses and security/government interest matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions relating to foreign filing licenses under 35 U.S.C. 184 and petitions concerning review of security or government interest matters not otherwise provided for.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions relating to applications under secrecy orders (expunge subject matter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions relating to any application under a secrecy order pursuant to 35 U.S.C. 181, including petitions to expunge subject matter from the application to overcome the secrecy order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for expedited examination of design applications (Tech Center 2900)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for expedited examination of design applications under 37 CFR 1.155.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP § 1504.30; authority delegated to Director of Technology Center 2900.

rubrics_metrics.name: CRU petitions under 37 CFR 1.181(a)(1) for reexamination proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.181(a)(1) from any action or requirement of any examiner in ex parte and inter partes reexamination proceedings including requests for reconsideration of a decision on such a petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegated to Director of Central Reexamination Unit (CRU); see MPEP § 1002.02(c) item 3 for supervisory review context.

rubrics_metrics.name: CRU petitions for extension of time in ex parte reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.550(c) for an extension of time in ex parte reexamination proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegated to CRU (further delegated to CRU Supervisory Patent Reexamination Specialists (SPRS)).

rubrics_metrics.name: CRU petitions for extension of time in inter partes reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.956 for an extension of time in inter partes reexamination proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegated to CRU (further delegated to SPRS).

rubrics_metrics.name: CRU petitions under 37 CFR 1.59 to expunge papers (reexamination)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.59 to expunge papers in reexamination and supplemental examination proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegated to CRU (further delegated to SPRS); see MPEP for procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions and matters decided by Supervisory Patent Examiners (SPE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Various authorities delegated to Supervisory Patent Examiners including entry of certain amendments, approval of reopening prosecution after filing appeal brief for new ground entry, certificates of correction requests (except clearly minor clerical errors handled by Certificates of Correction Branch), correction of inventorship errors for patents not in interference, disapproval of certain preliminary amendments and second supplemental amendments, suggested claims for interference purposes, and other specified matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions/matters decided by Chief Administrative Patent Judge (PTAB)
rubrics_metrics.description: Authorities of the Chief Administrative Patent Judge including re-delegation to various APJs, handling issues raised properly during ex parte reexamination appeals about substantial new question of patentability, ordering dismissals in the interests of justice, designation of PTAB members to review appeals and conduct proceedings, and superintending PTAB functions including policy questions, petitions to review non-compliant briefs, certification to disqualify counsel, extensions of pendency, and various petitions under 37 CFR 1.181/1.182/1.183 from PTAB actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP cross-references; includes 75 FR 36357 (June 25, 2010) for substantial new question authority and numerous 37 CFR and internal MPEP citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions decided by Administrative Patent Judges
rubrics_metrics.description: Matters decided by Administrative Patent Judges including certification of policy questions to Chief Administrative Patent Judge, motions to waive/suspend Subpart D rules of 37 CFR part 41, declarations/re-declarations of interferences, institutions/reinstitutions of derivation proceedings, and motions to suspend interferences involving patents under reexamination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions/requests decided by Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB)
rubrics_metrics.description: Matters decided by the PTAB including requests in reply/oral hearing to consider new arguments, requests in rehearing to review failure to designate new ground of rejection, petitions to institute trials, determinations of proper course in interference/trial, authorizations to file motions other than petitions to institute, and various motions (oral argument, arbitration authorization, sanctions, additional discovery, motions to exclude evidence, motions in limine).

rubrics_metrics.name: Matters decided by General Counsel / Office of General Law / Solicitor
rubrics_metrics.description: Matters include motions to compel testimony or production, motions related to taking testimony (including quash), admissibility of expert testimony, pro hac vice recognition of counsel, disqualification/withdrawal of counsel in inter partes/trial proceedings, motions to seal, motions to expunge confidential information, treatment of settlement agreements as BCI, motions by patent owners to amend in IPR/PGR, motions to submit supplemental information, motions to correct clerical errors in petitions for IPR/PGR, joinder requests, and requests to make settlement agreements available to government agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for confidentiality waiver under 35 U.S.C. 122
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for confidentiality waiver under 35 U.S.C. 122.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handled as specified in MPEP and applicable statutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to extend time for filing notice of appeal or commencing civil action (C.A.F.C.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions (under 37 CFR 90.3(c) or 2.145(e)) seeking to extend the time for filing a notice of appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit or for commencing a civil action seeking judicial review of a PTAB or TTAB decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions under 37 CFR 11.2(d)/(e) from Director of OED final decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 11.2(d) or 11.2(e) from a final decision of the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline regarding enrollment/recognition or disciplinary matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals under 37 CFR 11.55 and related proceedings (OED)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appeals under 37 CFR 11.55 of initial decisions of hearing officers and requests for reconsideration under 11.56(c) in proceedings under 35 U.S.C. 32 where OED seeks to exclude or suspend a practitioner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 37 CFR 11.55, 11.56(c); pertains to enrollment/discipline contested decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests/decisions by Office of General Law (FOIA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests filed under the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and administrative appeals of FOIA Officer’s decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handled by Office of General Law per MPEP delegation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions decided by Solicitor (court matters and ex parte questions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for extension of time in court matters under 35 U.S.C. 142, 145, and 146, and petitions relating to ex parte questions in cases before the Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit; Solicitor available to render legal advice to deciding officials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegation to Solicitor; see MPEP; citations to applicable statutes and rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests decided by Certificates of Correction Branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for Certificates of Correction under 37 CFR 1.322 or 1.323 except for denials requiring higher-level consideration; and requests to change inventorship pursuant to court order under 37 CFR 1.324.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions decided by Director of Office of Enrollment and Discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions regarding enrollment or recognition, requests for limited recognition, petitions for reinstatement, petitions to suspend rules under 37 CFR 11.3, and petitions to withdraw a Rule to Show Cause under 11.11(b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures when Deputy Director receives a petition
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon receipt of a petition to the Deputy Director, the entire file is forwarded to the Office of the Solicitor; the Solicitor reviews and prepares draft decision and may take interlocutory actions (extend times for filing oppositions, seek judicial review, obtain agreement on facts, etc.) as necessary to dispose of the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegation and procedural flow described in MPEP; Solicitor authorized to act as necessary to promptly dispose of petitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions decided by Director of International Patent Legal Administration (PCT matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: A broad set of petitions and requests in PCT/international matters: withdrawal of Notice of Acceptance/filing receipt for national stage 35 U.S.C. 371 matters; withdrawal of attorney in PCT Operations; petitions for access to international/national stage applications; fee refund requests; conversion petitions between 35 U.S.C. 371 and 111(a); petitions to withdraw holding of abandonment in PCT Operations; petitions under 37 CFR 1.137 to revive PCT-filed applications; pre-AIA signature acceptance under 1.47/1.42; requests under 1.48/1.28 for inventorship/small entity changes prior to national stage entry; petitions relating to priority claims, filing date matters, drawing problems, Chapter II demands, obvious mistakes, withdrawal; decisions withdrawing examiner’s actions for PCT noncompliance; petitions under PCT Rule 26bis.3 or 37 CFR 1.55/1.78 to restore priority or domestic benefit; petitions to accept delayed priority/domestic benefit claims in national stage applications; PCT-related issues in 111(a) applications; petitions for time extensions under 1.136(b) before International Patent Legal Administration; other PCT matters and requests for PPH participation or Make Special under international agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple 37 CFR and MPEP citations (e.g., 35 U.S.C. 371, 37 CFR 1.26, 1.181, 1.182, 1.183, PCT Rule 26bis.3); see MPEP § 1002.02(p) and related subsections for details and delegation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions dealing with Hague Agreement and international design applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions under 37 CFR 1.1023(b) to accord an international design application a U.S. filing date other than the international filing date; petitions under 37 CFR 1.1051 to excuse failure to act under Hague time limits; petitions under 1.1052 to convert international design applications to U.S. design applications; decisions withdrawing examiner actions for Hague noncompliance; petitions under 1.181/1.182/1.183 in international design applications; other Hague Agreement related decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 37 CFR 1.1023(b), 1.1051, 1.1052, 1.181, 1.182, 1.183; MPEP references for Hague Agreement implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director of OPAP petitions/requests (inventorship and conversions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests under 37 CFR 1.48 (on/after Sep 16, 2012) to correct inventorship in nonprovisional applications; 1.48(d) to add inventor in provisional; 1.48(e) to delete an erroneously named inventor in provisional; petitions to convert nonprovisional to provisional or provisional to nonprovisional where application is before OPAP; petitions under 1.182 to accept omitted pages/drawings and be accorded filing date; petitions for extension of time under 1.136(b) in applications before OPAP; petitions to withdraw attorney under 1.36 in applications before OPAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions decided by Director of Office of Data Management (withdrawal of abandonment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to withdraw holding of abandonment where a notice of abandonment has been, or could have been, properly mailed by the Office of Data Management.
